question: Who among the following is NOT a tabla player?
solution:
The correct answer is __**G N Balasubramaniam.**__

__***Key Points__**

__
 
• Gudalur Narayanaswamy Balasubramaniam popularly known as GNB, was an** Indian ****Carnatic singer.**
 
• He, along with his** contemporaries ****Semmangudi Srinivasa Iyer and Madurai Mani Iyer**, are mentioned as the **20th century male trinity of Carnatic music.**
 
• G N Balasubramaniam was also a** Tamil film actor. **
 
• Ariyakudi Iyengar motivated him.
 
• He appeared in films, including **Bama Vijayam* (1934), Sathi Anusuya (1937),*Sakuntalai* (1940), Udayanan Vasavadatta (1947) (with Vasundhara Devi, mother of Vijayanthimala) and Rukmangadhan**** (1947).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Pandit Swapan Chaudhuri (born 30 March 1945) is an Indian tabla player.
 
• Tanmoy Bose, whose name is frequently preceded by the title Pandit (Master), is **an Indian percussionist and tabla player, musical producer, and film actor.**
 
• Bickram Ghosh is an** Indian classical tabla player.** Bickram Ghosh was born in Kolkata, West Bengal.
